messageTr: Belge para birimi USD ama cac:PricingExchangeRate/cbc:CalculationRate yok.
messageEn: Document currency is USD but cac:PricingExchangeRate/cbc:CalculationRate is missing.
fixTr: <cac:PricingExchangeRate> ekleyin: SourceCurrencyCode USD, TargetCurrencyCode TRY, CalculationRate fatura tarihindeki kur.
fixEn: Add <cac:PricingExchangeRate> with SourceCurrencyCode USD, TargetCurrencyCode TRY and CalculationRate set to the rate on the invoice date.
